diagnosis: Customer in ap-south attempted to enable private networking. Per kb-0008, private networking is not available in ap-south; requests in unsupported regions remain queued rather than failing. Customer's business plan also lacks private networking entitlement per kb-0010 (premium only), which would return 403 if region were supported.
reply: Private networking is not currently available in the ap-south region. When attempted in unsupported regions, the request will remain queued rather than failing immediately. Additionally, private networking requires a premium plan. If you'd like to explore options for this feature, please let us know and we can discuss plan upgrades or regional alternatives.
